comparison.reader_policy: Separate primary-dose contrasts in post_ridge and trained_head panels; pre_ridge doses secondary, post-minus-pre ridge diagnostic. No single primary pose reader/reference selected; protocol clarification requires external Claude review before launch.

recipe.cache: pre/post mean_K FP16; trained post-head predictions FP32; original targets/masks unchanged
recipe.e2: historical full-window pairing and std exclusions; errors on intersection of crop6 masks
recipe.extraction: original pose_eval.extract ModelInputs; one unmasked FP32 teacher forward; same-forward pre/post
recipe.head: existing trained post pose head; separately identified, no supervised updates

ridge.cv: alternating sorted train users; two folds; pooled masked standardized SSE

recipe.support: common crop6 central target mask; original full-window pose_var threshold

post_ridge.scope: single seed, development users; no general FM promotion

pre_ridge.scope: single seed, development users; no general FM promotion

trained_head.scope: single seed, development users; no general FM promotion

comparison.scope: Frozen teacher; same crop6 held-user support. Trained head is historical and separate from equal-width ridge depth diagnostics. Descriptive development IC95, no multiplicity adjustment or between-training uncertainty.
